title: Media color and display capability schema
scope: Headless contract predecessor for the media train (G019 HDR10, G020 AV1/HEVC 4:4:4, G021 4K120/144+VRR). Defines the fine-grained video-mode descriptors and the negotiation downgrade matrix; the actual HDR/codec/high-refresh encode/decode/present is the downstream physically-gated work.
descriptors: VideoCodec (H264/HEVC/AV1), ChromaSubsampling (4:2:0/4:4:4), BitDepth (8/10), ColorPrimaries (BT709/BT2020), TransferFunction (BT709/PQ/HLG), MatrixCoefficients (BT709/BT2020NCL), ColorRange (Limited/Full), HdrMetadata (maxCLL/maxFALL/luminance), VideoMode, Capabilities. All descriptor codes are stable with forward-compatible from_u8 (unknown -> None).
negotiation: negotiate(client, host, requested) -> (VideoMode, Option<DowngradeReason>): keeps the exact request when both peers support it; otherwise downgrades codec (AV1>HEVC>H264 floor), 4:4:4->4:2:0, 10-bit->8-bit, HDR->deterministic SDR (BT.709 primaries/transfer/matrix, Limited range, no metadata), clamps refresh to the mutual max, and disables VRR — recording the first typed DowngradeReason. best_common_codec is the shared-bitset floor.

evidence_categories.rust_ts_truth_vectors: Identical negotiation outcomes pinned in Rust unit tests and TypeScript node tests (full match, HDR->SDR fallback, codec/chroma/bit-depth/refresh/vrr downgrade matrix, H.264 baseline floor).
evidence_categories.downgrade_matrix: codec_chroma_bitdepth_refresh_vrr_downgrade_matrix exercises every downgrade axis at once.
evidence_categories.malformed_property: descriptor_codes_round_trip_and_reject_unknown proves every descriptor's from_u8 rejects unknown codes and round-trips known ones; transfer.is_hdr() classification.
evidence_categories.c_contract: The Rust schema is the source of the generated C/TS bindings (existing capi/ts-rs mechanism); the descriptor codes are the C truth values.

notes: Finer-grained than and complementary to the coarse shipped StreamColorspace / StreamSettings.hdr; does not replace the existing moonlight VideoFormats negotiation. Reuses the G009 DowngradeReason for a consistent typed downgrade vocabulary.
